assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: All three JQL queries in discovery-listing.md use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024'. The file header explicitly references these as configuration values: 'Project: TC' and 'Vulnerability Issue Type ID: 10024', indicating they were sourced from configuration rather than hardcoded.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md contains three distinct JQL queries: (1) 'labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)' for untriaged issues, (2) 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New' for triaged-but-new issues, (3) 'labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, 'ON_QA')' for Ready for QA candidates. All three match the required patterns.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md has three clearly separated sections with horizontal rule dividers: '## 1. Untriaged Issues' (4 issues), '## 2. Triaged but still New' (1 issue), and '## 3. Ready for QA' (3 candidates with filtering rationale).

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: All issues display the required fields. For example, TC-9001: key='TC-9001', status='New', CVE='CVE-2026-40112', summary='h2 - HTTP/2 rapid reset vulnerability [rhtpa-2.2]', created='2026-06-08'. The Ready for QA table also shows all five fields for TC-9020, TC-9023, and TC-9026. TC-9010 in the triaged-but-new section also shows all fields.

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md explicitly states for TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004: 'Proceed with full triage (default path). New status indicates this issue has not been triaged or actioned.' For TC-9003: 'Warn the user before proceeding. This issue is already in "In Progress" status, which means it may be actively worked on by another engineer.' with options to proceed or skip.

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md filtering rationale: TC-9020 'ALL linked remediation Tasks are completed (TC-9021 Done, TC-9022 Closed). Ready for QA.' TC-9023 'Excluded -- TC-9025 is still In Progress. Remediation is not yet complete.' TC-9026 'Excluded -- no linked Tasks with link type "Depend" exist.' The Ready for QA summary table contains only TC-9020.
